notes.title: Achievements update #1!
notes.content: I've added 10 new achievements to the game for those who like that delightful little noise (and endorphin boost) that comes with unlocking them. None should be too difficult, though a few will take just a bit of skill. Good luck!

notes.title: Intro Cut Scene Added
notes.content:
Ever wonder why the intrepid Nine Lives Ninja is even exploring a deadly cave? Well now you can watch and find out!

Also added: the ability to skip the intro cut scene (along with all other fade in/out transitions).

notes.title: You can now Save & Continue in Adventure 2!
notes.content:
If you are playing Adventure 2 and set a save/respawn point, you have now also saved your progress for future sessions! Saves are also automatically created if you exit from the menu. You also get a free auto-save as you complete Adventure 2 in case you want to go back and find any more of those 99 emeralds you may have missed.

Also in this update: refreshed menu system and a few other small improvements.

notes.title: Nine Live Ninja: Explore! Price permanently reduced to $0.99
notes.content:
Based on reviews and feedback it is clear that I overpriced this game based on quality and quantity of the available content. This is my first solo game and I'm learning a lot through the process, and I appreciate anyone who took the time to play and let me know what they thought. With Steam's approval I am permanently reducing the price of Nine Lives Ninja: Explore to $0.99 USD and equivalent regional pricing. I will continue to improve the game and add more content in the coming weeks. That being said, if you purchased at full price I will completely understand if you choose to refund if you are still eligible to do so. 

I plan to continue my game development journey after this and hope that you'll consider sticking with me to check out future games. I believe they will improve with each iteration and I'll be exploring different genres along the way.

notes.title: Adventure 2 added - 4 times larger than Adventure 1!
notes.content: Come check out the largest (and hardest) level yet - Adventure 2! In addition to requiring more precision jumping and more exploration, there are also 99 emeralds to collect and a leaderboard to track the folks who get the most by the time they reach the fountain.

notes.title: New Mode: Score Attack!
notes.content: Time is not on your side, but what you collect is even more important than how quickly you reach the Fountain. Avoiding death will also help you set a high score!

notes.title: New mode: Time Trial!
notes.content: I've added a new mode for the speed runners and competitive folks out there. You can now play Time Trial, which is Adventure Mode with an ever-present clock silently judging your progress and accomplishments. Upon completion your best time will be added to a leaderboard for everyone else to see and compete against as well. Good luck!
